steps.description:
Show that your robot can perform in the following;

1. Display "Bus Moving" on the LCD until a button is pressed.

2. Wait for 2 seconds while still displaying "Bus Moving".

3. Display "Bus Stopping" for 1 second before performing step 1 again.

Show that your robot can perform in the following;

1. Display "Bus Moving" on the LCD until a button is pressed.

2. Play a sound for 1 second while still displaying "Bus Moving".

3. Repeat step 1 again.
